population: All 45 cases in eval/expanded/dev-cases.json; holdout not loaded
passage_recall: Distinct gold passage IDs with complete character coverage across the top k units divided by all distinct gold passage IDs. Merge overlapping spans; partial fragments do not get full credit.
fractional_passage_recall: Mean covered-character fraction across gold passages; a diagnostic alongside strict recall.
gold_passage_precision: Fully covered gold passages divided by distinct passage IDs returned in the top k units. Gold labels identify expected evidence, not every potentially useful passage; this is gold precision, not human-rated usefulness.
ndcg: Unit-level graded NDCG with linear gains and log2(rank+1) discount. Unit gain is the largest covered-character fraction of any gold passage in that unit. Ideal ranking sorts all applicable units by the same gain. Different units containing repeated gold evidence can receive relevance; passage recall and precision deduplicate passage IDs.
aggregation: Report macro means with explicit case denominators and case counts. Keep per-case scores and full/partial/missing evidence. Also report real/fixture, provider, scheme and query-type slices.
query_type: exact_code when the original question contains a Visa-style 10.x/11.x/12.x/13.x code or Mastercard-style 48xx code; otherwise no_explicit_code. This literal slice is not a judgement of question difficulty.
missing_evidence: Cases with labelled evidence absent from the applicable corpus stay in the denominator, score zero and carry a diagnostic. Do not omit failures.
no_gold_cases: Retain in reports with null recall/NDCG and separate counts. Empty results do not prove the system answered or abstained correctly.
latency: Record retrieval wall time separately from loading/model warm-up, note cache usage and report per-method median and p90. Do not treat rounded console seconds as exact.
controls: Same questions, filters, source units and gold labels across methods. Fixed BM25 preprocessing and RRF settings. Gold consulted after retrieval only. Preserve prior baseline files.
status: Metric implementation prepared; 45-case evaluation has not run
